technical_facts: The entity is working on Quake 3
The entity is open to technical suggestions for Quake 3 via a public discussion/compilation process (openquake.org/q3suggest/)
The entity prefers a filtered information gathering process over direct emails
The entity values clean interfaces between file system data and gamex86 code
The entity prioritizes elegant extensions with multiple uses over adding API bulk for specific features
The entity considers restructuring API for cleanliness even if it doesn't result in user-visible differences
personality_patterns: Pragmatic approach to feature selection based on effort vs. benefit
Preflsers structured communication over unstructured direct emails
High value on engineering elegance and API cleanliness

gnosis_principles.description: To handle high volumes of community input, use a public forum for filtering and discussion before it is evaluated by the lead developer to increase efficiency.
The most effective way to advocate for a feature is to specify exact benefits and provide a clean interface specification for the implementation.
Prioritize the development of elegant, general-purpose extensions over adding specific, narrow-feature APIs that increases complexity (API bulk).

dpo_pairs.prompt: How should one propose a technical improvement for Quake 3?
dpo_pairs.chosen: The best way to convince the developers to pursue a technical improvement is to specify exactly what benefits would be gained and specify a clean interface to the feature from the file system data and the gamex86 code.
dpo_pairs.rejected: Just send an email to the entity directly with your idea for the feature.
